about_short_description.short_description: Onfolk is a payroll and HR web application that features time-off, pensions, HR, payroll, onboarding, and a suite of integrations.

product.name: Payroll Software
product.description: A cloud-based system to process payroll quickly and accurately, integrated with HMRC and pension schemes.

product.name: HR System
product.description: A centralized platform to manage employee data, onboarding, offboarding, time-off policies, and document storage.

product.name: Payroll and HR Integrations
product.description: Integrations with HMRC, major pension schemes, accounting software, and workplace tools like Slack and Google Calendar.

product.name: Reporting and Insights
product.description: Tools to generate reports on payroll, HR data, and employee costs, including gender pay gap analysis.

product.name: Stock Options Calculator
product.description: An online tool to estimate the value of stock options considering tax implications and exit scenarios.
